summary: Two people on foot caught in an avalanche at Chedsey Creek, North Park; one partially buried, one fully buried and killed
notes: Run 83 CAIC 2011-12 thin-year chunk. CAIC summary only; no SAR team response confirmed. Run 635 Steamboat-Pilot-chunk merge (Denver Post 2012-01-24 repost, parent-opened): two Fort Collins brothers in their 20s (auto mechanics) in a snowmobiling party got stuck Saturday night 2012-01-21 near their Grizzly Creek campsite, east side of Buffalo Pass, then walked back on foot and were caught in the avalanche; the father located the surviving brother alive in a snow cave and a SAR helicopter spotted the pair; the other brother was confirmed dead Monday evening 2012-01-23. SAR response documented (DP confirms a SAR helicopter; unopened snowest.com thread search-index content reports RCSAR + Jackson County SAR + helicopters searched). Victims corrected 1->2 (two subjects: one fatality, one rescued alive). Location-note: DP places the slide at the Grizzly Creek campsite/east Buffalo Pass; CAIC's row location reads Chedsey Creek, North Park -- same 2012-01-21 Park Range, Jackson County, 1-fatality snowmobile-party avalanche per the CAIC 2011-12 table.
